exposure: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 420 term (≥37 weeks) infants born through MSAF between January 1, 2016, and December 31, 2017
finding: After the implementation of the 2015 NRP guidelines, there was a non-significant decrease in intubation rates at birth for infants born through MSAF, with no difference in morbidity or mortality.
birth_weight: Not mentioned, but infants were of similar birth weight between the two periods
